sqlite_sidecar_issue.root_cause: Preservation baseline v1 could capture a transient SQLite WAL/SHM/journal sidecar and later treat its normal disappearance or inode rotation as destructive loss.
sqlite_sidecar_issue.fix: Recognized top-level SQLite sidecars are excluded from new baselines and are narrowly treated as volatile compatibility exemptions in historical baselines; ordinary persistent files retain strict identity preservation.

create_only_collision_issue.root_cause: A settled startup forecast can produce new forecast evidence while the DemiHead create-only request path was derived only from stable base/context fields, causing a legitimate retry to reuse a path with different bytes.
create_only_collision_issue.fix: The immutable peer request ID now binds the predictor_forecast_receipt_sha256 prefix so every distinct forecast evidence package gets a distinct create-only path.
create_only_collision_issue.history_policy: No old v1_3 or v1_4 peer artifacts are deleted, renamed, moved, or overwritten.
